tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /man ngag nges pa'i kha byang ming rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la phyag 'tshal la ོ / /sku gsum nyid ni snang ba 'di nyid las/ /ma nor dbang po'i yul du gtan dbab phyir/ /man ngag yig chung gsal ba snying nor grags/ / me long nyid la bzhin bstan ji bzhin du/ /ma nor 'gyur ba'i sa med gsang chen nyid/ /snyigs ma'i dus su gang zag la la dag /snying po'i nor la ras chod gzu lum gyis/ /brtsams shing mun pa'i nang du khab gtor ltar/ / man ngag snying po dkrugs shing lhag chad byed/ /de rnams kyis ni bsnan phri byar med phyir/ /ming nges gsang ba'i kha byang 'di nyid ni/ /dam pa rnams ni lus ngag yid kyis kyang*/ /rab tu gus pas gsol ba btab nas kyang*/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su dgos srid pas/ /'khrul pa med pa'i blo yis 'bri bar bya/ /gsang ba'i man ngag yi ge 'di nyid ni/ /gcig la gcig dgos ma bu ma yin te/ /gnad kyi man ngag nges pa so so'i thabs/ /nges pa'i snying po man ngag nges pa'i grangs/ /bla med yongs su rdzogs pa'i sde tshan la/ /'di dag yi ge gsang ba'i gnad du phab/ /'di ltar ming gi kha byang nges pa la/ /gsang ba'i man ngag kha byang yi ge ni/ /nges par grangs su bcad na 'di ltar mchis/ /rgya cher bshad pa'i yi ge grangs mang yang*/ /rnam par bsdus na snying po'i don nyid ni/ /brgya dang bcu dgu nyid du bkod pa la/ /re res kyang ni grol ba'i snying po 'o/ /lta ba'i skor bzhi'i rtsa nges dum dum khrigs 1su ltos/ /ston pa'i lo rgyus la sogs po ti smug chung 2ltos/ /'khrul gzhi gsal ba'i me long 3nyid dang 'byung bzhi gnad yig 4dang*/ rin chen gser thigs 5nyid dang snang byed sgron ma 6dang*/ /'do gsal lde mig 7nyid dang shes bya skor gsum 8dang*/ /gsang ba'i sdom byang 9nyid dang sgra brtags 'khor lo 10nyid/ / ༈ sku gsum lag khrid 11dang ni mkha' 'gro pra khrid 12dang*/ /babs lugs gsum 13skor dang ni 'khrul ba'i sdom yig 14gnyis/

/gsang 15thig chen po dang ni gser 16byang bkol ba nyid/ /lam khrigs 17chen po dang ni ye shes 18lag phrad gnyis/ /bka' khrol 19chen po dang ni bsam gtan rang 20gnas gnyis/ / ༈ gsal ba'i me 21long nyid dang gsang ba nying 22bkol gnyis/ /snang ba bsdus pa 23dang ni gnas pa'i byung khungs 24gnyis/ khregs chod bdun pa 25dang ni thod rgal dgu 26pa gnyis/ /lung bstan chen 27mo dang ni glang chen drug 28pa gnyis/ /spyod lam bsdus 29pa dang ni lta ba'i gser 30bkod gnyis/ / ༈ padma'i klong 31yangs dang ni lha yi phyag 32sor ma/ /gser gyi utpal 33nyid dang dran pa rgyun 34gcod gnyis/ /rags pa 35nyams blangs nyid dang phra rgyun 36dril ba gnyis//gsal ba'i sgron 37ma nyid dang seng ge 38rtsal sprug gnyis/ /a ti rnal dgongs 39dang ni dgos don bzhi 40pa gnyis/ / ༈ rdo rje lam 41bstan dang ni rin chen 'od 'bar 42nyid/ /lhag pa'i 'khor lo 43dang ni khyung chen mkha' 44lding gnyis/ /lta ba'i mig sel 45nyid dang bla ma'i rim pa 46gnyis/ /drang ba'i 47tshig rgyud dang ni 'khrul gzhi rtsad chod 48gnyis/ / sems kyi dmigs drug 49nyid dang sgom pa'i 'khor lo 50gnyis/ / ༈ dbang gi lde 51mig nyid dang dbang gis las byang 52gnyis/ /spros med dbang gi man 53ngag dag dang dbang gi rtsa ba 54pa gnyis/ /dbang gi rigs 55'byed nyid dang dbang gi phra tig 56gnyis/ /'khor lo drug pa'i 57dbang dang dam tshig bar 58'byed gnyis/ /dbang bkod chen po 59nyid dang dbang sbyor pra 60khrid gnyis/ / ༈ rig pa'i 61me tog nyid dang gser 62lung chen po dang*/ /man ngag rtsa ba 63nyid dang lung tig bco brgyad 64pa/ /rig pa drug 65pa dang ni sems lung sgom khrigs 66gnyis/ /yang gsang 67dril ba dang ni sbas pa'i nyi 68ma dang*/ /'phra bkod bcu 69pa dang ni lung 70yig bsdus pa nyid/ / ༈ bdud rtsi yang 71zhun dang ni lung 72gsum 'dus pa nyid/

/gsang chen g.yu 73yig can dang man ngag phra 74yig can/ /gsang ba gser 75yig can dang snying gzer 76che chung dang*/ /bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo 77dang ni 'phrul yig 78che chung dang*/ /mkha' 'gro 79mdzod dang 'pho ba 80chen mo nyid/ /gsang ba'i gzer 81bu dang ni rtsa gnas 'khor 82lo dang*/ / bsam gtan 83babs lung dang ni rig pa sa 84'byed gnyis/ /snang ba rgyas 85'debs nyid dang ye shes sbubs 86'jug gnyis/ /lo rgyus 87chen mo nyid dang gsal ba'i zhal 88chems nyid/ /theg pa'i bsdus 89shan dang ni gsang ba'i sgra 90yig gnyis/ / ༈ yi ge'i 91sgra bshad dang ni sgra bzhi mtshams sbyor 92gnyis/ /bstan pa'i go 93cha ma dang 'gyur med thig le 94gnyis/ /dngos po'i kha 95bsgyur dang ni 'bras bu mngon byed 96gnyis/ /stong pa'i mtha' 97'byed dang ni nam mkha' 98lam khyer gnyis/ /thi bya tshang 99'jug dang ni gsal bar rin 100chen 'od/ /ka dag chen po'i dag 101yig dang ni lhun grub yi ge 102gnyis/ /shes rab 'khor lo dang 103ni smra ba'i mtshon chen 104gnyis/ ye shes lnga bskor 105dang ni 'od kyi tshul 106bshad gnyis/ /'byung ba'i gnas 107'byed dag ni sgron ma'i khungs gcod 108gnyis/ /phyag rgyas 109'dus pa dang ni bkod pa 110lnga pa gnyis/ /rgya mtsho ar gtad 111dang ni rlung gi sdom byung 112gnyis/ /ngo sprod gsum pa 113dang ni babs lugs 114bcu gcig pa/ /rtsa thig 115che chung dang ni rlung gis stems yig 116 dang*/ /rig pa gnas sa 117dang ni mig gi bsam gtan 118na/ /de ltar man ngag yig chung brgya dang bcu dgu ni/ /gcig la gcig brten ma yin 'brel med so so'i gnad/ /nges par gang zag re la phan pa dang*/ /dgos pa'i yig chung rgyud la phan pa dang*/ /snying po rab tu bsdus pa nyi tshe las/ /gnad med yi ge gcig kyang ma mchis sa ོ / /gsang chen dam pa'i yi ge 'di dag ni/ / mthar thug man ngag nges pa'i gnad yin pas/

/skal ldan sems kyi bu yis yid la chongs/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga nyid sa la goms pa yi/ /thabs kyi yan lag rnams su 'di dag 'dra/ /lhag pa'i yi ge gsar ba'i gnad 'di yis/ / gang gi dug gsum nad rnams 'don par byed pa 'a ོ / /gsang ba'i man ngag yig chung nges pa'i grangs/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'di nyid dgos srid pas/ /ma 'ongs skal ldan 'di la 'jug pa rnams/ /snying po don gyi yi ge'i grangs nyid las/ /the tshom blo yis spros pa gcod pa'i phyir/ /ma nor dmigs bstan man ngag nges pa'i grangs/ /the tshom bsal phyir man ngag nges pa yi/ /ming rnams nges pa'i kha byang 'di bris pas/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don 'di la/ / mos 'jug dad pa'i skal pa ldan pa la/ /mun pa'i nang du sgron me btegs pa ltar/ /ji ltar snang ba'i 'od kyis chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes par shog /man ngag nges pa'i kha byang ming rnam par bkod pa/ /slob dpon chen po bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs sa ོ/ / / / athi+-i/ rgya rgya rgya/ sa ma yā/ / dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (2)man ngag nges pa'i kha byang ming rnam par bkod pa/ -PAGE 240--PAGE 239--PAGE 238-
